title: Minkowski, Hecke, Landau, Sylvester, and Other Classical Mathematics Authors: Modern LaTeX Drafts
version: 2026-05-29 author cluster refresh: Landau English reader confirmed; Sylvester source scans preserved
description:
Linked author-cluster record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Public-Domain Mathematics Manuscripts project. This record presents reader-facing modern LaTeX drafts for selected works by Minkowski, Hecke, Landau, Steinitz, Hensel, Oka, Hausdorff, Grassmann, and Killing, with Sylvester source scans preserved for future typesetting.

Coverage at this release:

  • Reader PDFs: [##########] 10/10 public reader PDFs staged by author/work. The Landau reader is the English Goodman translation with publisher/translator front matter removed and mathematical text retained.
  • Sylvester source scans: [##--------] collected-papers source scans for Volumes I and IV are preserved in the artifact ZIP; modern LaTeX readers are pending.
  • Front-matter review: [########--] obvious modern collected-volume title/copyright/editorial pages removed from the public PDFs; source/provenance packets remain available for checking.
  • Source/provenance artifacts: [##########] source packets, TeX, component PDFs, source scans, and provenance reports preserved in the artifact ZIP.
  • Proofreading state: [###-------] machine-assisted working drafts; not proofed critical editions.

Public organization is by author and work. Source scans and provenance material are preserved in ZIP artifacts so the top-level PDF list stays focused on reader-facing compiled drafts.
notes: Current public-facing author-cluster record, organized by author and work. The Landau reader is an English translation; Sylvester source scans are included as source material pending modern LaTeX conversion.
